Airbus suppliers, shipyards and mills: how SNT-TC-1A and NAS 410 split Mobile's NDT work

Mobile became an airliner town within a decade. Airbus Americas assembles A320-family jets at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley, opened its A220 final assembly line there in May 2020, and is building a second A320 line, a project expected to create about 1,000 jobs. On the same waterfront Austal USA builds Navy vessels, the Calvert steel complex rolls plate and coil upriver, and Ingalls is a short drive west in Pascagoula. Depending on which gate you walk through, a Mobile NDT technician can meet four different personnel documents. The detailed comparison of the two main ones is in NAS 410 vs SNT-TC-1A.

NAS 410 and EN 4179: the aerospace twins

Companies machining, forming, painting or processing parts for airframe programs usually find one of these two in a purchase-order quality clause. NAS 410 comes from the Aerospace Industries Association; EN 4179 is its European counterpart, and the two have been kept technically aligned since the early 2000s. A Gulf Coast supplier with both European and US customers may see each named on different orders. In both, a Responsible Level 3 (RL3) designated in writing controls the program and decides what earlier training and experience to credit.

SNT-TC-1A: hulls, mills, plants and pipelines

Hull and structural welds at the Mobile River yards, plate and roll inspection at Calvert, turnaround work in the Theodore chemical plants and at the Pascagoula refinery, and pipeline welds to API 1104 are inspected under written practices built on SNT-TC-1A. AWS, ASME and API documents call for it; a few contracts name CP-189 instead.

NAVSEA requirements on Navy hulls

Navy shipbuilding and repair layer NAVSEA personnel and acceptance requirements over the yard's own written practice. The yard's Level III will tell you what additional qualification a Navy hull calls for and how the yard handles it.

Repair station manuals at the airport

Aircraft maintenance in the Brookley hangars follows whichever standard the repair station's manual and its customers' contracts name. The FAA leaves that choice to the organization: it certifies no NDT personnel itself, and Advisory Circular 65-31B lists NAS 410 and SNT-TC-1A among the acceptable standards.

Crossing from the shipyard to the aerospace side

The most common local move takes a shipyard VT or UT technician into aerospace work. An SNT-TC-1A certificate does not meet a NAS 410 or EN 4179 requirement by itself; the new employer's RL3 reviews the record and certifies you again under its own program. Penetrant and eddy current on aluminum details may be new methods, and the surface methods need more formal, documented training under NAS 410 than SNT-TC-1A recommends. Courses at the state's AIDT Alabama Aviation Center at Brookley, built to support the Airbus workforce, are worth asking about; keep their outlines and recorded hours if you want them credited later. Keep a signed experience log by method, your examination history and a current vision record with them.

For suppliers setting up near Brookley

New suppliers arriving for the second A320 line often take industrial or marine orders as well. Name the governing standard and revision on every certification, keep each program's records separate, and schedule the move of any NAS 410 program to Revision 6, released in December 2025, to your customers' dates. Nadcap AC7114 and customer auditors sample inspectors and trace each one back to training, experience, examination and vision evidence. Atlantis prepares and reviews NAS 410 audit documentation for your RL3 to approve, and builds aerospace written practices on SNT-TC-1A aligned to the customer's flow-down and Nadcap AC7114.

Atlantis on the Gulf Coast

Atlantis training is built on ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Theory is online and self-paced with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions, practice runs in the Practical NDT simulator, and the hands-on work and practical examination take place at your employer's yard, hangar or plant under its written practice. There is no Atlantis classroom in Mobile. Methods that matter for the airport side include eddy current testing training and penetrant testing in aviation; the wider route is on aerospace NDT training. Bay-area plants and terminals can call on Atlantis for UT, MT, PT and VT inspection.

For Mobile Bay readers, without hedging: Atlantis does not provide NAS 410 training, certification, examinations or a Responsible Level 3. Credit for SNT-TC-1A-based training toward a NAS 410 certification is the employer's RL3's decision, so ask before you enroll. How NAS 410 programs run is covered in NAS 410 explained.
